desktopPattern.name: Mac OS Default
desktopPattern.source: unobscured native framebuffer region; every RGB pixel must match the extracted ppat tile

appleMenu.source: stable native framebuffer; exact face pixels become transparent

MACS.source: Finder application-menu slot in the same stable native framebuffer

aliasBadge.source: opaque residual shared by three independently extracted custom icons over the proved desktop tile; every output pixel must agree across all three target regions and differ in at least two proofs

notes: This is the first explicit visual profile, not a claim that Mac OS 8.6 and 9.1 are identical.
Future profiles inherit only after an evidence-backed delta is recorded.
